subject: Staging bridgecheck & MAP sequencing — org setup, API keys, IP safelist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@cardiosync.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bridgecheck & MAP sequencing — first-pass checklist

Hi Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We agreed the next concrete step is a short MAP that gets our staging tenant into a minimal production-like posture so the clinical integration team can run inference workloads and smoke test data flows. I attached a draft MAP (cardiosync-map-draft-v2.pdf) and a preliminary IP list (staging-ip-list.csv).

High-level asks from our side: 
- Org setup: create a CardioSync staging org and invite two service users (svc-cs-ingest and svc-cs-eval)
- API keys: short-lived keys for the svc accounts and instructions for rotating them
- IP safelist: we will provide a CIDR list; want to confirm inbound allowlist for the inference endpoint
- VPC peering: request a peering endpoint so our staging cluster can push logs and reach the model runtime with minimal hops

Timeline preference: 2-week runway to full gating (we're aiming to start automated evaluation on 28 Mar). Can Redwood commit to the network checklist and a preflight call next Tuesday?

Notes: we have a security questionnaire in flight (ops@cardiosync.ai). If you need SOC or pen-test artifacts we can share them during the call.

Thanks,
Sara
Director of Integrations, CardioSync

Attachments:
- cardiosync-map-draft-v2.pdf (MAP draft, 3 pages)
- staging-ip-list.csv (IP/CIDR list, 12 rows)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@cardiosync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bridgecheck & MAP sequencing — org setup, API keys, IP safelist, VPC peering

Sara — thanks for the clear asks and the MAP. We've reviewed and can support the plan with the following commitments and a small set of preflight items. TL;DR: can hit your 28 Mar evaluation start if we close the preflight by 21 Mar and get your staging VPC details.

Commitments from Redwood (what we'll do):
1) Org & accounts
   - Create a staging org "cardiosync-staging" and invite svc-cs-ingest@cardiosync.ai and svc-cs-eval@cardiosync.ai (they will be scoped to token-only service roles)
2) API keys
   - Issue two short-lived API keys with rotation instructions (we'll provide an automated rotation script sample)
3) IP safelist
   - Support CIDR allowlist + optional ephemeral NAT for tighter egress control; we need the final CIDRs by EOD 20 Mar
4) VPC peering
   - Standard peering flow: exchange peering IDs, create routing entries, confirm MTU and DNS resolution; expected 48–72 hour turn once we have the egress CIDRs and peering ID

Preflight checklist (items CardioSync must provide):
- Staging VPC ID and preferred peering window (contact: ops@cardiosync.ai)
- Finalized IP/CIDR list (CSV) by 20 Mar
- List of scopes required for svc accounts (ingest vs eval)
- Acceptance criteria for the evaluation run (latency SLO, sample dataset size)

Proposed schedule:
- Fri 17 Mar: preflight call (30m) to confirm CIDRs and peering cadence
- Mon 20 Mar: final CIDR file delivered by CardioSync
- Tue 21 Mar: Redwood provisions org and issues keys
- Wed–Thu 22–23 Mar: peering & routing validation
- Tue 28 Mar: automated evaluation kickoff (CardioSync starts smoke tests)

I've attached a one-pager with the provisioning steps and a link to our MAP template in the body of this thread.

Would Marissa and Neha be able to join the preflight call on Friday at 09:00 PT? Jordan, can you add the peering runbook notes to the shared Drive link after the call?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0121

Attachments referenced:
- provisioning-onepager.txt (single-page checklist)
- https://drive.redwood/cs/CS-2028-0421/MAP-v2 (MAP draft location)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@cardiosync.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bridgecheck & MAP sequencing — org setup, API keys, IP safelist, VPC peering

Looping in operations notes and confirming the Friday preflight at 09:00 PT. Quick operational clarifications ahead of the call: 
- We'll provision the staging org namespace with the least privilege roles and send invite links to the two svc accounts; CardioSync should accept invites before Tue 21 Mar to avoid delays.
- API key model: we'll issue time-limited keys that expire after 7 days by default; we'll help you switch to a rotation flow if you want long-term evaluation.
- IP validation: please include any downstream egress endpoints (analytics, logging) in the CIDR file — missing those is the #1 root cause of failed preflights.
- Peering notes: if your VPC enforces strict ingress ACLs, expect additional routing adjustments; please share both the VPC route table and the security group defaults in the Drive folder.

Action items for the call (I will bring a short runbook):
- Review final CIDR rows (ops will verify reachability)
- Exchange peering IDs and schedule a 1-hour window (ops) for routing validation
- Confirm where CardioSync will host logs (S3, GCS) and whether we need cross-account roles

See you on Friday.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
